questions.stem: What is the total surface area of a cylinder with radius $3\text{ cm}$ and height $7\text{ cm}$? Give your answer in terms of $\pi$.
questions.explanation: Total surface area $= 2\pi r^2 + 2\pi rh = 2\pi(9) + 2\pi(3)(7) = 18\pi + 42\pi = 60\pi\text{ cm}^2$.

questions.stem: The curved surface area of a cylinder is given by which formula?
questions.explanation: The curved surface area of a cylinder is the area of the rectangular wrap-around: $2\pi rh$, where $2\pi r$ is the circumference and $h$ is the height.
